key_developments: The Hang Seng Index rose by 702 points to 24,199, breaking the 24,000 barrier with a 2.99% increase, driven by a net inflow of 141.96 billion Hong Kong dollars from northbound funds.
Alibaba's stock price surged 12.2% to 107.5 Hong Kong dollars, while Kuaishou rebounded 8.7% to 43.98 Hong Kong dollars after a previous day's 12% decline.

Morgan Asset Management's Asia-Pacific chief strategist Xu Changtai stated that a sustained rally in the Hang Seng Index requires two catalysts: new mainland policies to boost consumption and breakthroughs by Hong Kong-listed tech giants in applying AI.
The Hang Seng Index peaked at 24,310, with Alibaba and Xiaomi shares leaping 13.4% and 10.1%, respectively, driving the tech rally and resulting in a 4.5% climb in the Tech Index to 4,710.
Northbound funds' net inflow of 141.96 billion Hong Kong dollars supported the market, with the Hang Seng Index closing at 24,199, a 2.99% increase from the previous day.

articles.title: 摩根資管:港股後續升市須兩大催化劑配合
key_points: Morgan Asset Management Asia‑Pacific chief strategist Xu Changtai said the Hang Seng Index rose today as investors rebalance from Taiwan and Korea markets, pulling capital back into lagging Hong Kong stocks

He warned that a sustained rally needs two catalysts: new mainland policies to boost consumption – signals may emerge at the upcoming Politburo meeting – and breakthroughs by Hong Kong‑listed tech giants in applying AI to finance, consumer or healthcare sectors
He remains bullish on undervalued areas, citing high‑dividend banks, state‑owned enterprises and the power‑storage segment as attractive picks for global fund rotation

articles.title: AI丨智譜傳考慮自研晶片 應對GLM模型需求激增
key_points: 智譜 (stock 02513) is evaluating a custom AI chip to handle surging demand for its open‑source GLM large‑model series.
The initiative seeks to cut reliance on imported GPUs as U.S. export controls tighten compute‑resource availability in China.
Preliminary talks have begun with several domestic chip designers and a Chinese foundry to develop and fabricate the processor.
Anthropic, Samsung, Broadcom and OpenAI have launched similar AI‑chip projects, underscoring a broader industry shift toward in‑house hardware.
